idea-plugin.name: Veyra Aurora
idea-plugin.description:
The northern lights, in your IDE. A midnight-blue theme with aurora green, teal, ice blue and soft violet, plus a crisp light version. Easy on the eyes, beautiful in screenshots.

Two themes

  • Veyra Aurora: a deep midnight-blue sky with glowing aurora colours. Ice-blue keywords, aurora-green strings, teal functions, violet types, pink fields and starlight-gold numbers.
  • Veyra Aurora Light: clean white with the same palette, deepened for crisp, high-contrast code.

Every pixel themed

  • The whole IDE: toolbars, tool windows, tabs, popups, Search Everywhere, dialogs, the Run widget and notifications, 600+ parts of the IDE in one palette. On 2025.3 and newer you get the rounded Islands look.
  • Signature details: an aurora green-to-violet default button, an aurora-green caret and tab underline, a gold current line number and a green-to-violet progress bar.
  • Matching editor colour schemes for Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, Go, Rust, PHP, Markdown and more, plus the debugger, diffs, VCS, search highlights and the terminal.
  • Easy to read: every syntax colour meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) on its background, comments included.

How to use it

Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance → Theme and pick Veyra Aurora or Veyra Aurora Light. The matching editor colour scheme switches with it.

Made by FlightCoders, the team behind Veyra Studio. Prefer warm colours? Try Veyra Theme.
